info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Account Statement File Retrieval API
info.description: The Account Statement File Retrieval API allows users to access specific account statement files associated with a given account and statement ID. This API is particularly useful for financial institutions and application developers who need to retrieve detailed transaction records for customer accounts. By providing programmatic access to these documents, the API supports transparency in banking and financial services. Typical consumers include banking applications, accounting software, and compliance systems seeking to enhance user experience and operational efficiency.

get.summary: Retrieve the file for a specific account statement.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to download the file associated with a specific statement of a given account. You can access the file by providing the account and statement identifiers.
